Put the official OpenSCAD WebAssembly build here:

    vendor/openscad/openscad.js
    vendor/openscad/openscad.wasm

Download it from the Releases page of https://github.com/openscad/openscad-wasm,
then enter the release tag in THIRD_PARTY_NOTICES.md and set
ALLOW_CDN_FALLBACK = false in index.html.
